description.value: Congee Noodle King has been serving classic Hong Kong-style congee and noodle dishes to Vancouver diners since 2006. Located on Kingsway, it offers both dine-in and online ordering via their own app. The restaurant is a long-established local fixture in the Kingsway corridor, making it a solid fuel stop for cyclists passing through the area.
